item.title: “We go Harder as Individuals,”LaCabra on How Qwellers’ Members’Solo Releases Keep the Collective Active
item.description: LaCabra recently explained how The Qwellers continue to stay active through the solo work of their members during an appearance on the L-Tido Podcast New Gen. He noted that while the collective does not release music as frequently as a group, individual members consistently drop solo projects that sustain the collective’s momentum. item.title: Blxckie Reveals Playlist and Release Date for His Forthcoming Project ‘4LUV2 : B4YENA’
item.description: Blxckie has confirmed the release date and playlist details for his forthcoming project, 4LUV2. The project will consist of eight tracks and will feature contributions from DeityNow and Young Stunna. Positioned ahead of Valentine’s Day, 4LUV2 continues Blxckie’s ongoing output and adds to his growing catalogue within the local hip-hop scene.
